adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a new job `app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb` with branching behavior (raising `Discourse::InvalidParameters` when `embed_url` is missing, optional lookup of `User` by `user_id`, and passing `no_throttle: user.try(:staff?)` into `TopicRetriever`). The added specs cover `TopicRetriever`, `EmbedController`, `PollFeed`, and `TopicEmbed`, but there is no spec file for `Jobs::RetrieveTopic`, so these code paths are not directly exercised by tests in this PR. However, the claim that it would “crash on anonymous users” is not supported by the code shown: `user` is initialized to `nil` and `user.try(:staff?)` is safe.
